📖 How to use

      
  1. Pick 2×2 or 3×3.
  2. Type the coefficients of each equation.
  3. Press Solve system to see the elimination steps and the solution.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What if there is no unique solution?
A zero determinant (2×2) or zero pivot (3×3) means the system is inconsistent (no solution) or dependent (infinitely many) — the tool says which.
What is Gaussian elimination?
Rows are combined to zero out entries below the diagonal (forward elimination), then variables are solved bottom-up (back substitution).
Are the answers checked?
Yes — the 2×2 solution is plugged back into both equations so you can verify the residuals.
